decks.notes: The main focus of the deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, evasive creatures while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and tempo plays. By utilizing faeries and ninjas, the deck aims to maintain a steady stream of threats and card advantage. The addition of cheap removal spells and utility cards like Sewer-veillance Cam helps to control the board and protect the aggro strategy. The key to success lies in efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan while maintaining a consistent source of card advantage.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and quickly overwhelming the opponent with an aggressive, fast-paced strategy. By utilizing cards like Burning-Tree Emissary and Goblin Bushwhacker, players can flood the board with creatures early on and deal damage quickly. Support cards like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt provide additional reach and removal options, while Rally at the Hornburg and Siege Smash can help finish the game. The deck aims to apply constant pressure and win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

decks.player: Gabriel Espinosa De Los Monteros Escobedo
decks.notes: The main concept of this deck revolves around using Gates to ramp up mana and control the board with removal spells and protection cards. The strategy involves stalling the game with defensive creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Outlaw Medic, while using Writhing Chrysalis to create token blockers. Prismatic Strands and Thraben Charm provide protection against different types of threats, while cards like Malevolent Rumble and Journey to Nowhere help to remove opposing creatures. The inclusion of Armadillo Cloak provides some life gain and additional protection for your creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost, small creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of attackers. By maximizing the number of creatures on the battlefield and utilizing cards that buff all creatures or provide protection, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech enhance the effectiveness of going wide with small creatures, while cards like Prismatic Strands and Idyllic Grange provide support and ensure the creatures can stick around to deal damage.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of artifact creatures and powerful spells, while also taking advantage of the Affinity mechanic to cast spells for reduced costs. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through cards like Ichor Wellspring and Thoughtcast, and using efficient removal like Galvanic Blast and Terminate to control the board. It also includes a few sacrifice outlets like Blood Fountain and Makeshift Munitions to take advantage of creatures like Myr Enforcer and Utrom Monitor. The mana base is optimized for fast and consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and sacrificing artifacts to deal direct damage to the opponent. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures while controlling the board with removal spells and artifacts that provide additional value. The key strategy is to generate card advantage through artifacts like Ichor Wellspring and Thoughtcast, while also utilizing cards like Galvanic Blast and Makeshift Munitions to finish off the opponent. The deck's synergy and ability to quickly close out games make it a formidable aggro deck in the Pauper format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to your opponent using low-cost spells and creatures, while also utilizing cards that allow you to draw additional cards or gain advantage through ramp spells. By consistently applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Guttersnipe and using burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Fireblast to target your opponent's creatures or life total, this deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, evasive creatures like Faeries while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and bounce effects. By consistently applying pressure on the opponent and controlling the board, this deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total and secure a swift victory. The inclusion of card draw and disruption spells ensures that the deck can maintain its tempo and outmaneuver the opponent, ultimately leading to a successful aggro strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy utilizing a swarm of Elves. By using cards like Avenging Hunter, Nyxborn Hydra, and Timberwatch Elf, the deck aims to build a strong board presence early on. Cards like Land Grant, Lead the Stampede, and Winding Way help to ensure a steady stream of Elves to keep up the pressure. The deck is focused on quickly building a formidable army of creatures to overpower the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost artifacts to power up the affinity mechanic and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer and Refurbished Familiar, along with artifact synergies like Ichor Wellspring and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and deal damage efficiently. Krark-Clan Shaman and Makeshift Munitions provide additional removal options, while Thoughtcast helps maintain card advantage. The mana base is optimized for artifact spells, allowing for smooth gameplay and maximizing the deck's potential.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly flood the board with artifact creatures and take advantage of the affinity mechanic to reduce their cost. By using cards such as Myr Enforcer and Refurbished Familiar, along with cheap artifact spells like Galvanic Blast and Thoughtcast, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. Additionally, the deck includes some control elements like Nihil Spellbomb and Krark-Clan Shaman to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining pressure on the board.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells while also utilizing artifact synergies. By combining efficient creatures like Krark-Clan Shaman and Nyxborn Hydra with spells like Cast Down and Terminate, the deck aims to control the board and keep the pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Ichor Wellspring and Lembas helps to draw cards and generate value, while cards like Cleansing Wildfire and Drossforge Bridge provide additional utility and flexibility in different game situations.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures and apply pressure on the opponent. It is designed to disrupt the opponent's resources with removal spells while also generating card advantage through sacrificing artifacts and creatures. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Cast Down and Cleansing Wildfire while also having ways to ramp up and generate value with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Refurbished Familiar. Overall, the deck prioritizes quick aggression and resource management to overwhelm the opponent.

The focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal, while also generating value with creatures that provide card advantage like Mulldrifter and Augur of Bolas. The key card in this deck is Ephemerate, which can be used to reuse powerful enter-the-battlefield effects like Mulldrifter or Archaeomancer. By consistently disrupting the opponent's game plan and generating card advantage, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponents until it can secure a win condition, whether through creature beats or other means.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost creatures, focusing on white creatures with a mana curve that allows for rapid deployment. The deck also includes a mix of support cards such as guardians' pledge and prismatic strands to protect and buff your creatures, along with some removal options like thraben charm. The goal is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy that can quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent.
